clusters.pick_reason: PR #2478 uses a module-level _restore_mcp_error callable — the correct pickle-protocol pattern, since pickle requires the reconstructor to be importable by name — and it covers all MCPError subclasses via from_error_data dispatch, not just UrlElicitationRequiredError. PR #2439 only adds __reduce__ to the one subclass and returns the class itself as the callable, which breaks if the class is renamed or if other MCPError subclasses need the same treatment. PR #2478 also removes an incorrect # pragma: no cover annotation as a minor bonus.
